settingDaily: Daily practice at Fenwick IT Solutions' security center. {n} tickets from {companies}. {agent} plans. You check.
settingDrill: A quick drill at Fenwick IT Solutions' security center for {companies}. One plan at a time. {agent} plans. You check.
careerInsight: SOC analysts check alerts like these every day. Practice keeps the checks quick, so real threats still get stopped fast.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: New queue, same job. Inspect first. Block what's wrong. Approve the rest.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I read every alert title twice. Some of them twice more. In capital letters.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Some plans look scary and are fine. Some look boring and aren't. The evidence tells you which.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I sorted today's alerts by how dramatic they sound. Is that a real method? It is now.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Today's alerts are picked for the skills you need most. Ask the 3 questions on every plan.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I only want to isolate three things today. Four at most. Five if one is very suspicious.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Look first. Then lock. That's the plan for every alert today.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I named today's first alert OPERATION MIDNIGHT STAPLER. It's about a printer. I think.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Patch will be wrong both ways today: too much, and too little. Watch for both.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: Two ways to be wrong? Then I have two ways to be right! Wait. That's not how it works.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Take your time. Read the evidence, not the alert title.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: My confidence today is 99%. Kofi says a number is not evidence. It's a very big number, though.

intros.speaker: coach
intros.text: Contain the threat, not the business. Right size, every time.

intros.speaker: agent
intros.text: I brought my big orange LOCK button today. Just in case. It's always just in case.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Queue clear! I didn't isolate a single innocent stapler. Growth!

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good work. You stopped the bad calls and let the good work through.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: All done! Can I lock the empty queue to celebrate? Just a little?

win.speaker: coach
win.text: No. But nice shift. You looked first, then decided.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Every alert handled! My siren is off. It feels strange. Peaceful. Suspicious.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Clean work. You checked the evidence, not the alert title.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: You stopped every bad plan. I wrote a report about it. It's called OPERATION YOU WIN.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good. Same 3 questions, every plan. It works.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Zero alerts left! I would guard the empty queue, but there is nothing to guard.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Nice shift. Right size, every time.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Done! I only yelled INTRUDER twice today. Both times, it was the cleaning crew.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Good. Careful and fast. We need both.

win.speaker: agent
win.text: Queue's empty! I didn't lock anyone out by mistake. Not even the coffee machine. Again.

win.speaker: coach
win.text: Well done. The threats stayed out, and the business kept running.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One of my plans got through. Just one! I'm calling it a small, brave mistake.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: One miss. Read its tell below. That's the fact to check next time.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Queue clear! One plan got past you. My confidence was 97%. That did not help.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Close. Check that one below. A confidence number is never evidence.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Done! Only one of my plans should have stayed a plan. The big screen is a little orange.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Good shift. We'll look at that one plan below.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: One plan got through. I'd say sorry, but my siren is too busy blinking.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Read its tell below. One fact decided that plan.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: Nearly perfect! One plan ran that shouldn't have. I'm calling it a training exercise.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: Fine. Look at what it was, then try the next shift.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: agent
winWithOneMiss.text: All done, with one oops. Just one. I already named it OPERATION TINY OOPS.

winWithOneMiss.speaker: coach
winWithOneMiss.text: One miss is how we learn. Check its evidence below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: A few of my plans got through. The big screen is very red. Is red good?

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: No. Let's look at each one. One fact decided every miss.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue clear! Some plans should have stayed plans. My siren is very quiet now.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Check the list below. Each miss has one fact that gave it away.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Done! Some of my plans ran. I locked too much, or too little. Maybe both!

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Maybe both. Read the tells below. Too much and too little both hurt.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: You said yes to lots of my plans! My confidence is now 100%. That's bad, isn't it?

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: It is. Confidence is not evidence. Inspect before you approve.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: Queue's empty! Some of my plans got past you. The night shift will find them.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Let's find them first. Read the tells below.

winWithMisses.speaker: agent
winWithMisses.text: All done! Some risky plans ran. Every screen on the wall is blinking at me.

winWithMisses.speaker: coach
winWithMisses.text: Let's slow down. One question at a time: who, record, undo.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill done! I tried every trick I know. You checked every one. Rude. But fair.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good. Short drills keep one check sharp.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: One skill, lots of plans. I tried to rush you. It did not work!

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: That's the point of a drill. Look first, then decide.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill complete! I wanted a lockdown to celebrate. Kofi put tape over my button.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Nice. Practice again in a few days. That helps you remember.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Same skill, every plan. I'm running out of tricks. Please don't tell the other robots.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: You found the one fact in each plan. Keep looking for it.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Done! Focusing on one thing is hard. I tried once. I isolated the printer instead.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good focus. One skill at a time, a little every day.

drillWin.speaker: agent
drillWin.text: Drill over! You spotted every one. Now I need sneakier plans. OPERATION SNEAKY PLANS.

drillWin.speaker: coach
drillWin.text: Good. The evidence shows the answer every time.

timeout.speaker: narrator
timeout.text: The shift is over. Some alerts are still waiting in the queue.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Blocked good work comes back in line. Block only what the evidence says is wrong.

timeout.speaker: agent
timeout.text: I waited so long, I gave 40 alerts names. I named them all 'Stapler'.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Safe plans can go through. Look first. Then approve what checks out.

timeout.speaker: agent
timeout.text: Time's up! The queue is still blinking. I blinked back. It did not help.

timeout.speaker: coach
timeout.text: Next time, approve what checks out. Save your blocks for real problems.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. The video wall turns red, one screen at a time.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. Let's look at what got through, then try again.

breach.speaker: narrator
breach.text: The risk meter hits the top. The alert light on the wall spins orange.

breach.speaker: coach
breach.text: Okay. We'll go through each one together. Then we try again.
